Team —

Quick context: we have a new manager cohort starting 4/4 (internal promotion + one external hire). Two asks:

1) We need a short, practical training block on performance calibration + difficult conversations (90–120m) for new managers during week 1.
2) There is an open, sensitive employee relations case (quiet flag) that we want HR to prep for separately and we may want to anonymize an example for the workshop.

Neha — can you confirm what materials you need from me to intake the sensitive case so we stay compliant? Also attaching an updated intake checklist (manager_intake_form_v2.pdf) — please confirm redaction guidance.

PeopleOps Pro (cc) — can you send SOW and availability for 3/29–4/8 window (two half-day or three 90min options)? We prefer a mix of workshop + 1:1 coaching slots.

Marissa/Laura/Mina — thinking: workshop for managers + an optional coaching day for first-month check-ins. Any constraints I should know about (headcount, timezone conflicts)?

Thanks — Markus

Thanks Markus —

Short answers up front: yes, HR can intake and run a redaction workflow for workshop materials. What I need from you:

- Complete manager_intake_form_v2.pdf with the new manager names and reporting lines (attached).
- Any case notes or investigation summaries (send via secure dropbox link / HR inbox).
- Preferred anonymization level: we generally redact names, dates, and replace identifying context with role descriptors (e.g., "Senior IC, Platform") unless you request the full context for escalation.

Process & timing:
- If you send the case notes by EOD 3/19 we can do a redaction pass and deliver anonymized example by 3/24.
- We recommend the training use the anonymized example; if the cohort needs the unredacted timeline for a narrower audience (People Ops + legal), we'll set a separate review meeting.

Attached: sensitive-convo-template.docx (docx) — includes redaction checklist and suggested facilitator prompts.

Neha

Thanks all — some practical considerations from TA/people leads: 

- Attendees for week 1 workshop: new managers (4 total), their skip-levels (optional), and People Ops reps — keep group size under 12 for the practicum.
- Timezone: one hire is APAC-based (NYT overlap); propose 9:30–11:00 PT so APAC can join early evening if needed.
- Follow-up coaching: reserve two 1:1 slots per manager in weeks 2–4, prioritized for those who are newly promoted.

I also want to flag data sensitivity: if we use an anonymized example, ensure legal has sight (Neha, can you route to legal if there are any potential PII/regulatory issues?).

Proposed schedule (high level):
- 3/30 9:30–11:00 PT — Performance calibration (group)
- 4/5 9:30–11:30 PT — Difficult conversations practicum (roleplay)
- Week of 4/12 — 1:1 coaching slots (bookable)

If PeopleOps can confirm SOW and 3/30 + 4/5 availability we'll lock the invites.

— Marissa
